coverLibrary.title: Cover Library
coverLibrary.tileSubtitle: Upload your own photos for 'Find a Match' posts
coverLibrary.universalDescription: Used when none of your activity-specific photos match a post's category — and instead of an AI-generated image. Typically a portrait of you.
coverLibrary.universalEmptyHint: No universal cover photo set yet.
